description: JSON output schema for `bb auth login --json`. Data describes the stored credential result.

aliases.description: Discovered or configured host aliases stored for this server context.

host.description: The Bitbucket Data Center host that credentials were stored for.

used_insecure_storage.description: True when the system keyring was unavailable and the config fallback was used.

bb_version.description: Version of the bb binary that produced this document. Provenance for stored output, not a compatibility switch: pin the binary to pin the contract (ADR-064).

limit_reached.description: Present on listing commands: true when the result set came back at --limit and there may be more behind it.

title: bb auth login output
